features.behavior: Public source and releases use akunilovskii/salut only. The clean public history is independent of retained signing material, which stays outside Git. Source export flattens reviewed dependency sources and omits keys, private instructions and local state. Release builds preserve the existing package and certificate, use increasing versions and enable the existing GitHub update flow with its existing global About preference and hourly automatic check. Downloads and installation require user action. Debug development builds retain disabled automatic checks. Version tags trigger tests, signed APK builds, identity verification and release publication. Older private builds need one manual update. GitHub release notes export only the tagged version section from CHANGELOG.md, preserving its complete Markdown. Unreleased and other versions are excluded; missing, empty or duplicate sections stop publication before signing-key restoration. GitHub Actions tests and release jobs run on Ubuntu 24.04; shared PowerShell 7 build and test helpers also support local Windows builds.

features.behavior: Adapted NewTube PR #128 reload/engine-restoration fixes and PR #137 quality selection. Settings defaults persist separately from player-sheet per-video overrides. Temporary quality/audio choices survive same-video reloads and clear on different videos. Saved default presets remain adaptive ceilings so small-window caps remain effective. Explicit player choices select a matching or supported lower quality; Auto remains adaptive. HLS reused IDs must also match resolution, codec and frame-rate class. Track/source refreshes retain the intended target, clear stale overrides and retain an orientation-independent ceiling when no track matches. Global speed, original-language audio selection, background video disabling, viewport caps, personal controls and bounded error recovery are preserved. The conflicting permanent-pick and no-recovery policies from #128 and the fixed-default policy from #137 are excluded. No new preference store, background job or network API is added.
